pattern: bash -c 'nohup alacritty --class keytest -T keytest -e sh -c "stty -icanon -isig -echo min 0; timeout 12 cat -v" >/tmp/opencode/keytest.out 2>/tmp/opencode/keytest.err & sleep 3; w=$(xdotool search --class keytest 2>/dev/null | tail -1); echo "w=$w"; if [ -n "$w" ]; then xdotool windowactivate --sync $w; sleep 0.5; setxkbmap -layout us; xdotool key ctrl+a; sleep 0.4; xdotool key ctrl+x; sleep 0.4; setxkbmap -layout ru; xdotool key ctrl+cyrillic_de; sleep 0.4; xdotool key ctrl+cyrillic_che; sleep 0.4; xdotool key ctrl+cyrillic_te; sleep 0.4; xdotool key cyrillic_ef; sleep 0.4; setxkbmap -layout us,ru -option grp:alt_shift_toggle; sleep 0.3; xdotool windowkill $w; fi; echo "=== hex ==="; xxd /tmp/opencode/keytest.out'
